methodology.source: Saved test risk scores and alert_episode_id
methodology.snapshot_metrics: Computed on each group's snapshot subset; active windows are also deduplicated within the subset
methodology.ordinary_event_groups: component_type/aircraft_model use event entity attributes, event_month uses event_date; snapshot month uses snapshot_date; detection uses saved episodes from the whole test split
methodology.missing_pattern_event_groups: An event must have at least one valid scoring link with this missing pattern; the event counts as detected in this group only if a link of this pattern enters a saved episode; events may belong to multiple pattern groups
methodology.groups_may_overlap: Months may share episodes; missing-pattern scoring opportunities and events may overlap; episode/event counts across groups are not directly additive
methodology.small_sample_unstable_rule: n_snapshots<100 or actual_event_count<30; descriptive stability flag only, not used for selection or tuning
